'''Muelin''' is a contortionist in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Muelin|Muelin}}

==Activities==
Muelin previously performed in a competing show that was nearly destroyed by a rioting mob.{{ref/book|5|40}} After escaping from that unfortunate circumstance she was hired by Luca in the summer of 999NE.  She lived with other contortionists in a virulently yellow wagon.{{ref||Muelin}}
